intent: Keep selected-repository context on actual read requests, preserve raw application ownership before mixed-lineage formatting and completed session-owned recovery, and prevent a new evidence correction from stacking after an earlier failed-round correction.
acceptance: Only leading unquoted read requests can activate the selected-repository heuristic. Quoted spans preserve multiline data and backslash escape parity; in-word ASCII or curly apostrophes do not close a quote. Complete inline delimiter runs and valid whole-line code-fence closers bound quoted material, with conservative end-of-input consumption when unclosed.

Direct selected-repository read questions, polite or repository-scoped read instructions and technical questions about prompt handling remain recognized; the noun prompt alone does not establish a creative transformation.

Observe raw application-report, retained-content, non-answer and atomic Combined-answer ownership monotonically before markup buffering combines output lineage. Later plain text cannot reactivate evidence correction, while published mixed-origin attribution remains truthfully UNKNOWN.
A session that owns tool-result recovery retains final response ownership, including real GitHubVerifiedSession retained diagnostic reports.
A prior protocol or output recovery does not gain an additional no-evidence retry; all original exact-count, empty-round, protocol, output-limit and no-dispatch assertions remain intact.
Initial ordinary model prose with available GitHub tools can still receive the existing single bounded evidence correction.
Authorization, privacy, cancellation, tool admission, accepted budgets, continuation and verification-only behavior remain unchanged.

source_review.scope: Independent immutable-source review; no application execution claim.

coverage.qualification: These are source obligations, not executed test results. Exact-head hosted compilation and complete ordinary/heap/device/native checks remain required.
coverage.mixed_lineage_fixture: Retain four origins, one provider request, zero tool executions and no correction notice; replace the invalid raw-event equality with complete delivered text, MODEL_TEXT prefix and UNKNOWN mixed suffix, one final completion and no failure.

limitations: Selected-read intent remains a conservative bounded heuristic. Ambiguous requests containing listed text or creative object nouns before the selected target may omit automatic context.
Source and formatter review do not establish Kotlin execution, Android or provider behavior. Canonical host evidence and exact-head hosted results must retain their actual source identity.
No physical-device acceleration, listening, energy, general answer-quality or provider-retention claim is made.
followup_findings: Paired multiline inline code with single or double backtick delimiters could expose its selected-target text to the earlier heuristic.
The prompt noun exclusion incorrectly removed context from genuine technical questions about prompt handling.
ASCII multiline or escaped single-quoted text and in-word ASCII/curly apostrophes could expose a later selected target.
A fixed-three fence alternative could close before a complete longer delimiter; a fence closer with trailing prose could also expose quoted material.
